lines.en: Stretches tongue, moves slowly.
Dripping sound, hangs down.
Tongue reaches for prey, tightens.

lines.zh: 洞顶上倒挂着，舌头先下来。
lines.en: Hung from the ceiling, my tongue comes down first.
Licker moves slowly.
Dangles, waits.
Tongue extends, grabs.
Dripping, moves slowly.
Tongue wraps, consumes slowly.
Dripping, mixed with saliva.

lines.zh: 舌根发力，倒挂着挪向阴影。
lines.en: Tongue anchoring, I crawl through the shadows upside down.

lines.zh: 黏舌拖地，留下一道湿痕。
lines.en: My sticky tongue trails a wet line across the stone.
Lazily hanging tongue.
Empty eyes stare down.
Awaits prey.
On the cave ceiling, waiting for footsteps.
Hangs motionless, silent.
Lazily stretches tongue.
Empty eyes wander.
Silently waits.
Lazily hangs from the ceiling.
Empty eyes seem lost.

lines.zh: 一滴唾液坠向黑暗深处。
lines.en: A drop of drool falls into the dark.

lines.zh: 洞顶的钟乳石上，我纹丝不动。
lines.en: I hang motionless among the stalactites.

lines.zh: 胃里空空的，舌头却很有耐心。
lines.en: My stomach is empty, but my tongue is patient.

lines.zh: 洞穴的风吹动我垂下的舌尖。
lines.en: Cave wind stirs the tip of my hanging tongue.
Tongue suddenly moves.
Tip of tongue feels you.
Locks eyes on you.
Detects you, tongue moves.
Focuses on you.
Tongue touches your scent.
I hang from the cave roof, waiting.
Tongue touches your shape.
Target locked, tongue extends.
Tongue rushes to you.

lines.zh: 你抬头时，我正倒挂在上方。
lines.en: When you look up, I am already hanging above you.

lines.zh: 舌尖嗅到你的体温，轻轻颤抖。
lines.en: My tongue tastes your warmth and trembles.

lines.zh: 洞穴顶上，两只眼睛睁开了。
lines.en: Two eyes open on the cave ceiling.

lines.zh: 你的火把照亮了我的唾液。
lines.en: Your torch glints on my saliva.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，一下又一下。
lines.en: I count your footsteps, one by one.

lines.zh: 阴影里伸出一条湿滑的东西。
lines.en: Something wet slides out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 你听见滴水声，那不是水。
lines.en: You hear dripping. It is not water.

lines.zh: 我垂下的舌头对准了你的后颈。
lines.en: My hanging tongue aims at the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 你走近洞穴深处，我笑了。
lines.en: You walk deeper, and I smile.

lines.zh: 倒挂的猎手认出了活物的气味。
lines.en: The hanging hunter knows the smell of living meat.
My tongue retracts to the ceiling, hissing.
Half my tongue is cut off, it hurts.
Licker coming!
Taste my tongue!
Ha ha, you can't escape!
Don't struggle!
You can't go back!
Got you!
Enjoy my kiss!

lines.zh: 舌头被砍断了一截，好痛。
lines.en: A piece of my tongue is cut off. It hurts.

lines.zh: 你无法抗拒我的魅力吗？
lines.en: Can't resist my charm?
Be devoured, mortal!
Tasty treat.
Join me!

lines.zh: 你不知道我的舌头有多长吗？
lines.en: You don't know how long my tongue is.
Enjoy my taste.

lines.zh: 倒挂在洞顶，舌头先探出去。
lines.en: Hanging from the ceiling, my tongue goes first.

lines.zh: 我的舌头会把你拖进来。
lines.en: My tongue will bring you in.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道飘上来了。
lines.en: Your scent drifts up to me.
Come closer, let me lick you.
Avoid! My tongue!

lines.zh: 我倒挂在洞顶，等你抬头。
lines.en: I hang from the ceiling; look up.
Taste my sharp tongue.

lines.zh: 湿冷的舌头卷住你脚踝。
lines.en: My wet cold tongue coils around your ankle.

lines.zh: 快走开，不然你会后悔的。
lines.en: Move away, or you'll regret it.
Hanging upside down, my tongue tip dangles.
You're too slow.

lines.zh: 舌头已经碰到你的肩膀。
lines.en: My tongue already touches your shoulder.
Taste my tongue.
My tongue tip sticks to your armor.

lines.zh: 我舌头一伸，你就离地了。
lines.en: My tongue flicks out and you leave the ground.

lines.zh: 我倒挂着，舌头先垂下来。
lines.en: I hang upside down, tongue dangling first.

lines.zh: 我倒挂在洞顶，舌头先下去。
lines.en: I hang from the cave roof and send my tongue down first.
You're my other half.
Stay together.
Join my family.

lines.zh: 洞里只有我一只在等你。
lines.en: I'm the only one in this cave waiting.
Don't go, stay in this cave with me.
Forever together.

lines.zh: 倒挂着，我把舌头递给你。
lines.en: Hanging upside down, I offer you my tongue.

lines.zh: 那黏腻的舌头，竟成了我的梦魇！
lines.en: That sticky tongue became my nightmare.

lines.zh: 被吸进这洞穴，注定难逃一死！
lines.en: Drawn into this cave, destined for death.

lines.zh: 舔咬之口，藏匿洞穴深处！
lines.en: Licker hides deep in the cave.

lines.zh: 触手可及，却又遥不可及！
lines.en: So close, yet so far.
Prey within reach of the ceiling.

lines.zh: 抓住机会，品尝新鲜猎物！
lines.en: Seize the chance to taste fresh prey.
A tongue roll, and you'll see.
You'll be my meal.
Taste remains in the slime.
Devour prey, recover health.

lines.zh: 我的舌头，将带给你终结！
lines.en: My tongue will bring you an end.
Feel my approach?
Tongue-tip terror.
I'll enjoy your struggle.
Prey, within reach.
Your lifeline, my tongue.
Feel the fear of the lick.
My drool drips onto your head.

lines.zh: 享受这即将到来的终结！
lines.en: Enjoy this impending end.
My tongue will end it all.

lines.zh: 舌尖一弹，先缠住你的脚踝。
lines.en: My tongue snaps out and wraps your ankle.

lines.zh: 洞顶的暗影开始向下滑落。
lines.en: The shadow on the ceiling begins to slide down.

lines.zh: 你踩进了我舌头够得着的地方。
lines.en: You stepped within reach of my tongue.
The prey is below. I am above.

lines.zh: 舌头拉直了，像一根湿绳。
lines.en: My tongue stretches taut like a wet rope.

lines.zh: 等的就是你走到正下方。
lines.en: I waited for you to stand right beneath me.
Target locked, soon to be torn.
I judge the distance, then extend my tongue.
Tongue-tip prey.
One flick of the tongue and the trap closes.

lines.zh: 舌尖上的猎物，即将化为灰烬！
lines.en: Tongue-tip prey, soon to be ashes.
Wait, wait, until the end.

lines.zh: 舌头从顶上垂下来，找你。
lines.en: My tongue drops from the ceiling, hunting you.

lines.zh: 舌尖上的猎物，即将品尝！
lines.en: Tongue-tip prey, about to be tasted.
Locked, locked, tearing moment.

lines.zh: 舌头对准你的方向绷紧。
lines.en: My tongue pulls taut in your direction.

lines.zh: 缠住了，往回收，一点一点。
lines.en: Caught. Reeling you in, inch by inch.
The more you struggle, the faster I pull.
My tongue tightens around your waist.
Dragging you over gravel, toward my mouth.

lines.zh: 你脚下的地面正在后退。
lines.en: The ground is sliding away under your feet.

lines.zh: 我听见你的指甲刮着岩壁。
lines.en: I hear your nails scraping the rock.

lines.zh: 倒挂的身体绷紧了，准备进食。
lines.en: My hanging body tenses for the meal.

lines.zh: 别抓那根藤，它撑不住你。
lines.en: Don't grab that vine. It won't hold.
Three blocks left between you and my teeth.

lines.zh: 唾液顺着舌头流到你身上。
lines.en: Saliva runs down my tongue onto you.
Lunge with tongue to grab you!
Tongue snatches your breath!
You're my treat!
Clamp and drag you down!
My fangs sink into your shoulder.
Tongue licks your life!
Hanging here, waiting for this bite.
I hang above; my tongue arrives first.
Once I bite, I don't let go.
I drag you into my mouth and chew.

lines.zh: 一口咬下，伤口立刻合拢。
lines.en: One bite, and my wounds close.

lines.zh: 你的血肉滑进我的喉咙。
lines.en: Your flesh slides down my throat.

lines.zh: 咬住肩膀，把你提离地面。
lines.en: I bite your shoulder and lift you off the ground.

lines.zh: 嚼碎骨头的声音，真好听。
lines.en: The sound of crunching bone is lovely.
Every bite makes me whole again.
My tongue delivers you into my mouth.
Awaiting prey in the cave!
Nighttime hunting begins!
Sense your presence!
I dangle from the ceiling, hunting you.

lines.zh: 洞穴是我家，猎物是食物！
lines.en: Cave is home, prey is food!
Wait for the perfect moment!
Caves hold dark shadows!
Hunger's Licker!
Seeking fresh flesh!
Waiting for you!

lines.zh: 基岩下的洞穴里，我睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes in a cave beneath the bedrock.

lines.zh: 骨荒原的顶上，多了一条舌头。
lines.en: A tongue now hangs above the Bone Wastes.

lines.zh: 血肉平原的洞顶粘着我。
lines.en: I cling to the ceiling of the Flesh Plains.

lines.zh: 从黑暗里垂下来，无人察觉。
lines.en: Dropping from the dark, unnoticed.

lines.zh: 失落文明的洞穴，又添住客。
lines.en: The caves of the lost civilization gain a tenant.

lines.zh: 湿滑的声响先于我的现身。
lines.en: A wet sound comes before I do.

lines.zh: 在你看不见的高处，我成形了。
lines.en: I take shape high where you cannot see.

lines.zh: 洞穴隧道里，多了一双空眼。
lines.en: A pair of hollow eyes joins the tunnel.

lines.zh: 我挂在这里，等第一个猎物。
lines.en: I hang here, waiting for the first prey.

lines.zh: 深处传来一声黏腻的喘息。
lines.en: A sticky breath sounds from the depths.
Fire! I'll burn you!

lines.zh: 舌头还在上面，我掉下来了。
lines.en: My tongue is still up there. I fell.
Into the water!
Boom! I'll explode you!
Arrow coming!
Magic! I'll curse you!

lines.zh: 洞里没有猎物，舌头好饿。
lines.en: No prey in this cave, my tongue is starving.
Lightning! I'll shock you!
Void! I'll devour you!
